# |<---- max 72 characters ---->|
#
# Types: feat | fix | refactor | test | chore | docs | perf | style | revert | ci
#
# Scopes: service-order | saga | messaging | clients | domain | api | db |
#         k8s | compose | local | docker | bootstrap | ai

# fix(messaging): ignore replies whose saga is not running

# chore(compose): update postgres image version
